ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JR1 Aggressive targets the JobGiver hotspot measured by JD1 AutoTrace. JD1 showed that ClosestThingReachable, RegionTraverser.BreadthFirstTraverse and global fallback dominate slow JobPackages, including 150-750 ms stalls. JR1 keeps the JS1.2.1 Lean Hybrid HasJobOnThing/nearest-order behavior, then adds one-JobPackage reuse of exact Regionwise BFS Region order for repeated root/TraverseParms/maxDistance/maxRegions searches and a supporting Region.Allows memo. WorkGiver candidate validators are still evaluated live on every search; Jobs and reservations are not cached. ReachProfile also replaces the lifetime 16-mismatch fuse with an 8192-sample rolling soft fuse, 3600-frame forced-live cooldown, 256-clean-sample probation recovery and a 16/256 emergency hard fuse. RegionHint remains retired. This is an aggressive performance playtest build intended to attack main-thread JobGiver spikes first; compatibility regressions are expected to be fixed from runtime feedback.
